title: Wheelset buying overview
readyTitle: Ready to buy after the checks?
readyBody: QUICKBUY lets you start selecting wheelset-related products from this guide, then review the selected items before adding them to cart or going to payment. You can also check component categories, freehub fit, tubeless installation, appearance and logo choices, wheel building service, and safety notes before you place the order.

step1.title: Start with the riding use
step1.body: A useful wheelset choice starts with the bike and riding style, not with a single spec. Decide whether the build is mainly for road speed, climbing, gravel comfort, trail control, e-bike load, or a replacement wheel that must match an existing setup.

road.title: Road / climbing
road.body: Prioritize lower weight, predictable handling, and a rim depth that suits local wind and terrain.

gravel.title: Gravel / all-road
gravel.body: Prioritize tire volume, rim durability, and a setup that stays comfortable on mixed surfaces.

mtb.title: MTB / trail
mtb.body: Prioritize impact resistance, spoke count, hub standard, and serviceable replacement parts.

replacement.title: Replacement wheel
replacement.body: Match the existing axle, brake mount, freehub, rim depth, spoke count, and tire clearance first.

step2.title: Check the specs that can block compatibility
step2.body: Use these quick tools to estimate the main compatibility choices before ordering. The detailed pages open in a new tab, so you can keep this buying path open while checking the full explanation.

tireWidth.title: Tire width and rim fit
tireWidth.body: Confirm the tire size you want can work with the rim inner width and your frame clearance. Use the rim system toggle to view the backend engineering model's TSS or TC inner-width recommendation.
tireWidth.helperTitle: Tire and rim width quick check
tireWidth.helperDescription: Enter the tire width you plan to use and choose the rim system. This is a width quick check, not a separate tube-vs-tubeless calculator.

tireSystem.title: Tube, tubeless and tubular check
tireSystem.body: After checking the width row, confirm the actual tire/rim system. A rim-brake clincher, tubeless-ready TC rim, hookless TSS rim, and tubular rim can use different rim-bed designs; tubeless and hookless need tire approval and pressure limits, while tubular is a separate glued tire system.

freehub.title: Freehub body
freehub.body: Match the freehub body to the cassette standard before choosing hubs or a complete wheelset.
freehub.helperDescription: Select your drivetrain brand and groupset to estimate the freehub body you may need before opening the full compatibility section.

step3.title: Then choose how to configure and buy
step3.body: Once the core compatibility checks are clear, move into the actual order path. Use QUICKBUY for a fast product selection flow, or open the wheelset sections below when you need to confirm parts, tire systems, appearance, wheel building and custom services, or safety checks before installation.

quickBuy.title: Configure and buy with QUICKBUY
quickBuy.body: Open the QUICKBUY builder to select available wheelset-related products, review the selected items, then add them to cart or go directly to payment.

custom.title: Need custom work
custom.body: For mullet setups, single front or rear wheel replacements, or mixed rim profiles that need confirmation before purchase, open wheel building and custom services.

safety.title: Safety before riding
safety.body: Before installation or the first ride, review the wheelset-specific safety checks: plastic tire levers, torque and brake-pad checks, impact inspection, spoke tension, and stop-riding warning signs.
